items.title: The AI build-out has a problem that $1 trillion in cash can't fix
items.summary: Forecasts are rising for how much money Big Tech will throw at the AI data center build-out this year. But money may not get the job done if chips, skilled labor, and power bottlenecks stand in the way.

items.title: Cisco Just Gave Investors 3 Big Reasons to Be Bullish
items.summary: Cisco just posted its strongest earnings surprise in years, yet the stock dropped sharply the next day. Whether that selloff is a warning sign or a rare entry point comes down to three catalysts that most investors are overlooking.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Rises as It Bets on Robots
items.summary: Nvidia  stock has been on a good run recently, and its push into robotics could help it keep going.  The chip maker has signed a memorandum of understanding with South Korea’s LG Group to develop a humanoid robot.  Nvidia shares were up 0.1% at $225.62 on Friday.

items.title: Nu Holdings Jumps 10% to a Five-Month High, StoneCo Drops 6% as Nubank Breaks From the Pack
items.summary: Nubank just posted a result that sent its stock to a five-month high while every fintech peer around it fell flat or dropped hard, and the reason why reveals something important about where Latin American banking is heading.

items.title: AXT, T1 Energy and Babcock & Wilcox Soaring Higher On Friday
items.summary: AI's hunger for power and bandwidth is lifting stocks you would never expect, pulling a semiconductor substrate maker, a domestic solar upstart, and a restructured industrial into the same orbit as the chip giants.
